name: MuMu: Worlds of Connections
summary: Embark on an extraordinary adventure in MuMu: Worlds of Connections! In the MuMu (the multispecies multiplex), something's gone awry on the farm lab, and your mission, if you dare to accept it, is to maintain the delicate balance of this unique ecosystem while growing an abundant supply of apples for your community. In this mind-bending game, you'll seamlessly switch between the perspectives of a human scientist, an inquisitive prairie dog, a wise apple tree, and an ambitious planting robot. Shrink or grow
